parameters.functionScript:
/*
 * ASK ONCE, ON ARRIVAL (TASK-L171 §1). Nothing is wired to this node's Run, so
 * the runtime runs it once when its script loads — which is when the page that
 * places this component mounts. That is the whole trigger: the roster has no
 * parameter, because the backend decides whose people these are from the
 * session (`role:staff` in nodegx.security.json), never from anything a page
 * sends.
 */
Outputs.ask();

metadata.comment: The fixture's Static Data node stood here and emitted its rows on load. A Function with nothing on Run also runs once on load (simplejavascript.ts, NDA-017 §2), so the call happens exactly when the fixture used to arrive, and no page changes.

nodes.label: roster — staff only, from the backend

metadata.comment: The backend's `roster` function (components/__cloud__/roster). Its output IS the fixture array this component used to hold (L170, proven by tools/check-read-functions.mjs), so fr_order below is unchanged. The gate is role:staff in nodegx.security.json — one place.

nodes.label: A refusal is an empty list

parameters.functionScript:
/*
 * A REFUSAL IS AN EMPTY LIST (TASK-L171 criterion 5). A signed-in learner who
 * types /people is refused by the backend, and the page must render its empty
 * state rather than wait forever for rows that are not coming. The reason is
 * NOT shown: the backend answers every refusal with one body on purpose, so a
 * caller cannot tell "not yours" from "not there" (the mcp/auth.ts rule).
 */
Outputs.items = [];

metadata.comment: Runs on the Cloud Function's failure only (its Run is wired).
